# clearml_project (Data Source)

Looks up one ClearML project by its exact full name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clearml_project" "production" {
  name = "platform/production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `default_output_destination` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags` (Set of String)
